{"code": "import numpy as np

# Check for missing values in the two columns of interest
missing_in_columns = df[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].isnull().sum()
print(missing_in_columns)

# Drop rows where either column has missing values to compute correlation
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Compute Pearson correlation
pearson_corr = df_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(df_clean['body_mass_g'])

print(f"Number of rows after dropping missing: {len(df_clean)}")
print(f"Pearson correlation: {pearson_corr:.4f}")"}
